pages.title: An Orchard, Not a Log Pile
pages.text: Harvest repeatedly from a living tree.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Bone Meal speeds fruit growth. A full Winemaker outfit can save it at a durability cost; grape variety and vine state matter when choosing supports.

pages.title: Grow jungle grapes on a lattice
pages.text: Plant jungle vines on a Lattice. Right-click harvests ripe grapes, Shears remove the plant, and an axe separately changes the supports.

pages.title: Harvest a fruit-bearing tree
pages.text: Harvest ripe apple or cherry leaves empty-handed without chopping down the tree. Bone Meal speeds the next fruit crop.

pages.title: Save Bone Meal with workwear
pages.text: A complete Winemaker outfit can save Bone Meal by spending durability. All four pieces must occupy their correct slots.
